recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up in FHIR core is needed for FHIR-47419 unless the work group separately chooses to revisit older short-display wording outside the approved applied scope.
issue_request: FHIR-47419 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request asking whether Device.udiCarrier and DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier were sufficiently harmonized, because both had been described as "Unique Device Identifier (UDI) Barcode string" while Device had deviceIdentifierSystem and DeviceDefinition did not. The approved clarification updated Device UDI carrier wording, clarified DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier as the DI/UDI-DI portion, added identifier-system elements in DeviceDefinition, and aligned the deviceIdentifierSystem long definition across Device and DeviceDefinition.
initial_application: Earlier source history already applied the issue: 3cf635fa2b6 updated Device.udiCarrier short/long wording, d44784371677 applied PR #3573 for Device carrierAIDC/carrierHRF wording plus DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier and identifier-system additions, and 3466769d5835 fixed the final Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifierSystem definition after a revert/reapply sequence.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists both Device and DeviceDefinition resources and marks them approved, so the inspected StructureDefinition XML files are current build-scoped source. OO minutes show the text was revised in October 2024 and voted persuasive 8-0-0 on 2024-11-25 with the final deviceIdentifierSystem wording. Zulip search found no directly relevant or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Device.udiCarrier, Device.udiCarrier.carrierAIDC, Device.udiCarrier.carrierHRF, Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifierSystem, DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier, DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.deviceIdentifierSystem, and DeviceDefinition.regulatoryIdentifier.identifierSystem definitions already convey the applied resolution, including the final issuing-agency namespace wording requested in the Jira comments.
